simulation.scope: Single-slot af_ring_store model; no real receive core/CMAC; block header carries mask/count, downstream zero-fill not implemented yet

synthesis.scope: OOC synthesis only; no routed result, no real receive core or CMAC integration

limits: Reader streams present sources only; block_mask/block_count are the zero-fill contract for downstream
done waits for all samples to be accepted by downstream, holding the ring slot until drain
Missing sources between present ones cost one scan cycle each; full block is 2566 cycles for 2560 words
No polarization pairing, calibration, products, integration, or output FIFO yet
No routed timing, DRC, CDC, or post-route netlist simulation
next: Connect reader to a real af_receive_core descriptor/read/data/done boundary
Add zero-fill/antenna-pol mapping and polarization pairing/products/integration
Add finite output FIFO and sustained/backpressure ledger
Then start M4-02 low-L beam closure
